notes.title: 🚨 We just hit 6,000 downloads!
notes.content:
🚨 We just hit 6,000 downloads!


I made Is This A Platformer? solo, and now thousands of people have it in their Steam library — this feels surreal.


Thank you so much to everyone who's checking it out. If you’ve played it and enjoyed it, a short review helps a lot. ❤️
